steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Bring in an n8n workflow Preview" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Drop a workflow you exported from n8n. Foundry tells you what it does, which of its steps it could translate into its own, and what to watch for. It runs nothing, and it can't run an imported workflow yet.

  - paragraph: In n8n, open the workflow and use Download. The file stays on this computer.
  - button "Choose an exported n8n workflow (a JSON file)"
  - paragraph:
    - text: Planned Zapier exports, Make blueprints and GitHub Actions.

steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Bring in an n8n workflow Preview" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Drop a workflow you exported from n8n. Foundry tells you what it does, which of its steps it could translate into its own, and what to watch for. It runs nothing, and it can't run an imported workflow yet.
  - text: Choose an exported n8n workflow (a JSON file)
  - paragraph: In n8n, open the workflow and use Download. The file stays on this computer.
  - button "Choose an exported n8n workflow (a JSON file)"
  - heading "Thank customers when an invoice is paid" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: Does not translate into Foundry steps.
    - listitem:
      - text: "Planned Leave it in n8n and have Foundry call it through its webhook, asking you before each call: designed, not built, so nothing here can set that up yet."
      - 'link "What you can do today: pick the matching card"':
        - /url: "#/"
    - listitem: "Can't be translated yet, because:"
  - list:
    - listitem: A condition the prototype cannot translate into the IR's condition language. (Only fully paid)
  - heading "Risk card" [level=3]
  - term: What it does to the outside world
  - definition: Send thank-you (gmail, send); Log to sheet (google-sheets, append) read from the file
  - term: Safe to repeat?
  - definition: "No: Send thank-you retries on failure, and it writes outside, so a retry can do it twice read from the file"
  - term: Does anything check it worked?
  - definition: No check of the outside steps' results was found inferred
  - term: Does anyone approve it?
  - definition: "No: nothing in the file asks a person before acting read from the file"
  - paragraph:
    - text: "Foundry ran nothing. n8n keeps running your workflow as before. Of 10 sample n8n files, 2 translated into Foundry steps without errors and 8 were refused with reasons. Calling all 10 in place, in n8n, is designed but not built. 0 were run. Preview (A small, skewed sample of open-licence files. Nothing was executed, and translating a workflow does not show it behaves as it did in n8n: running one needs connectors Foundry doesn't have yet.)"
    - 'link "Where this comes from: n8n import: what translates, and what doesn''t run yet"':
      - /url: "#/claims?c=C06"
      - text: (source)
  - paragraph:
    - text: Planned Zapier exports, Make blueprints and GitHub Actions.
    - 'link "What you can do today: pick the matching card"':
      - /url: "#/"
